limits.text: At 10 eV kappa/(hbar*v)=1.1664; strong classical/quantum asymptotic separation is absent. This is a conditional classical leading-log evaluation, not a physical accuracy certificate.
At the 0.1 eV cutoff E/(k_B*T)=11.6045; no thermal equilibrium or complete bath/neutral/ion equilibration is established. Cutoff residual is not heat.

Prescribed bath and Coulomb-only drift are closure assumptions. Neutral energy transfer, electron-ion exchange, Fokker-Planck diffusion, magnetic effects and actual plasma feedback are omitted. The neutral-frequency condition is not an independently quantified physical admission.

Ramp source is the leading local H*t approximation. The 6.929996788504416e-7 difference is a three-time source-coefficient sample comparison, not a uniform interval error bound or exact Bianchi electron history.

Only electrons born directly at 0.1–10 eV in 1–4 MeV proton impact collisions are included. Higher-energy cascade feed, photons, near-thermal matching and remaining proton/electron tails are unresolved.

The independent ODE shares the physical closure/constants; source checks share inherited inputs. Agreement establishes bounded implementation/numerical consistency, not external physical validation. The integrated ledger by subtraction alone would be insufficient; separate ODE storage integrals provide an additional check at four cases.
The 0.07049798025544476 comparison uses parent terminal heat as a scale. It is neither the complete heating suppression nor a rigorous lower bound.
